related_information: If any failure code is displayed, perform troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.remedy: Use recommended fuel described in Operation and Maintenance Manual.

steps.cause: Use of oil out of specification
steps.point_to_check: Oil out of specification is used
steps.remedy: Use recommended oil described in Operation and Maintenance Manual.

steps.point_to_check: Check exhaust gas color . (See standard value table.) (Reference: See Testing and adjusting, “Exhaust gas color”).
Measured blowby pressure is higher than standard value.

steps.cause: Defective seal on turbine side of turbocharger
steps.point_to_check: Check if turbocharger shaft is not loose when rotated (by manually moving the turbocharger's blade axially and vertically).
Check for high oil level (If oil is added too much, it becomes high temperature and is deteriorated rapidly).
steps.remedy: Lower oil level to appropriate level.

steps.point_to_check: Visually check oil cooler element for dirt (temperature rise caused by dirt of oil cooler element)
steps.remedy: Oil cooler element repair or replacement

steps.cause: Breakage or wear of piston ring
steps.point_to_check: • Measured blowby pressure is above standard value. • Measure compression pressure (See standard value table). (Reference: See “TESTING AND ADJUSTING”, “Testing compression pressure”.)

steps.cause: Wear or damage of valve guide or stem seal
steps.point_to_check: • Check valve guide and stem seal. • Remove cylinder head and check guide internal surface and stem seal for damage (Reference: See Maintenance standard).
steps.remedy: Valve guide and stem seal replacement
